title: From inexistence to existence he came to many and was as one received: existence with existence he was with any as any with any: from existence to nonexistence gone he would be by all as none perceived.
html_source: A possible interpretation: At birth, an infant is perceived generically. Throughout life, though a person may be perceived as interacting with others in no extraordinary manner, by the time he reaches death, he would be perceived by all in a way that was, in actuality, as none perceived. No one would understand the true nature of the person, not even those closest to him.
